title: The Scatterhand Discipline
summary: The Azure Sky school discipline of the scattering hand that never strikes twice in the same manner.

title: Manual of the Broken Rhythm Guard
summary: The school manual of a guard that keeps no rhythm and so cannot be timed or beaten by timing.

title: The Azure Disorder Canon
summary: The school canon of the open sky field in which disorder is spread by design and ordered chaos wins the exchange.

title: The Sapphire Chaos Crown
summary: The apex discipline of the Azure Sky chaos line which crowns a formed core with a sovereign disorder.

title: The Gale Oath Discord Course
summary: The Gale school course in which the sworn oath is the anchor from which discord is thrown at the foe.

title: Reckoning of the Unsteady Line
summary: The school reckoning of the battle line that wavers on purpose to draw the foe into a broken advance.

title: The Gale-Sworn Anarchy Canon
summary: The school canon that swears itself to unruled wind and makes anarchy a field of qi the sworn alone can walk.

title: The Stillcore Tempest Discipline
summary: The apex Gale discipline in which a formed core holds a calm oath while the whole tempest of chaos turns about it.
